resolution.quote:
adding support for static transforms in python listener.
 Fixes #46

notes: Verified this session: issue #46 title and body verbatim (the failed-condition quote is the issue title; the reproducer and the no-data effect are the body), and the issue has no comments at all (comments API returns empty). Code verified at 17e57137dda28bf7e1d23a007e44e0eee404d26d: tf2_ros/src/static_transform_broadcaster.cpp line 42 'publisher_ = node_.advertise<tf2_msgs::TFMessage>("/tf_static", 100, true);' (latched) while tf2_ros/src/tf2_ros/transform_listener.py line 52 is only 'rospy.Subscriber("/tf", TFMessage, self.callback)' — the python listener the view_frames.py node runs subscribes only /tf, so the boundary-crossing topic mismatch is real; the C++ tf2_ros::TransformListener at the same revision subscribes both (transform_listener.cpp lines 72-73), confirming C++ consumers were a different, unaffected composition. Fix verified in the a2f8eea patch: '+        rospy.Subscriber("/tf_static", TFMessage, self.static_callback)', '+    def static_callback(self, data):' forwarding to 'self.buffer.set_transform_static(transform, who)', the tf2_py binding '{"set_transform_static", setTransformStatic, METH_VARARGS},' with 'bc->setTransform(transform, authority, true);' and the comment '// only difference to above is is_static == True'. Eligibility: two nodes interacting only through topics are separate units per S1 even in one repository; the minimal resolving change adds a subscription and a static-aware buffer entry point (the consumer's referenced interface changed), and a /tf_static->/tf remap would not be the resolution taken (it would insert an expiring non-static transform), so E2 stops at 6, interface kind topic; PAIR is right (no provider revision change documented). Class 'other' concurs: the source documents no provider-side move of data from /tf to /tf_static, so element_removed_or_renamed would not fit; a missing consumer-side subscription has no named class. Resolution recommended is right: the commit closed the issue but no run of the reproducer against the fixed listener is shown (no comments exist). The inventory listing topic:/tf with only the consumer side is a schema quirk the spec explains; it does not affect these verdicts.
